name: estimator-validity-v0

environment.third_party_runtime_dependencies: none; Python standard library and pytest

config.contrast_scale: standard orthogonal contrast, level 0 minus level 1

canonicalization: Remove only generated_at, then JSON encode with sorted keys, compact separators, ASCII escaping, and disallow NaN.
negative_evidence: A preserved earlier run with large planted effects and clipping to [0.05, 0.95] had alternative coverage 0.804. It is documented in the experiment log and was not used as the final artifact.
The change from the clipped to the unclipped design is consistent with the coverage shortfall but is not an isolated clipping-only ablation.
notes: This artifact validates an estimator on a declared synthetic balanced design.
It is not an LLM experiment, an AGI capability result, or evidence of benchmark novelty.
No GPU, model download, external dataset, network call, paid API, account change, or submission was used.
The finite-sample FWER, power, FDR, bias, RMSE, and coverage values do not guarantee behavior under arbitrary dependence or on real agent outcomes.
The original eight AGI research-point list from the user has not yet been supplied, so no eight-point mapping is claimed here.
not_completed: No arbitrary-factor-count estimator was implemented; this version supports at least two factors with a complete two-level design.
No unequal-cell weighting or non-Bernoulli outcome model was evaluated.
No confirmatory test on real agent data or external benchmark was performed.
No literature-backed novelty assessment was performed for this estimator.
